# `sec_comment_files`

**Selected SEC comment files**

One selected comment resource with all listing occurrences and source roles retained.

**Coverage.** Sampled. Complete selected retained rulemaking and comment-resource observations. Listing roles and discovery basis remain distinct; broader publisher coverage and current publisher state require separate evidence. *(measured 2026-10-13)*

- **Parquet file:** `sec_comment_files.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `file_id` | `VARCHAR` | Source file identifier where stated; SEC uses a reader-generated resource identity. |
| `rulemaking_id` | `VARCHAR` | Reader-generated identity joining the selected rulemaking observation and its comment resources. |
| `file_url` | `VARCHAR` | Source-declared selected file URI. |
| `format` | `VARCHAR` | Maintained reader classification of the selected resource format. |
| `pdf_version` | `VARCHAR` | Version stated by the retained PDF header; a byte-format observation. |
| `body_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 of the selected resource or archive-member bytes. |
| `observed_at` | `VARCHAR` | Recorded acquisition observation time; null when unrecorded. Separate from publication time. |
| `occurrences_json` | `VARCHAR` | All native listing occurrences, preserving order, repeated links and source roles. |
